title: niphobolus nummulariifolius
intro: Niphobolus nummulariifolius, commonly known as Nephrolepis nummularifolia, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Nephrolepidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus nummulariifolius include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
